title: A group of his brothers and sisters was sitting round the table.
html_source:
Notice how this is the second time that Stephen’s siblings have come up.

With his “renunciation” of his extreme religious devotion and his abandonment of promiscuity (among other things), his siblings are observed.

You can really see Stephen starting to notice things apart from himself, especially in the descriptions to come later in the chapter.
